svg.title: Approach to a neurological problem: describe it (onset, course, deficits), localize the lesion (cortex, subcortex or brainstem from the brain pearls; the list of places that weaken both legs; dysarthria and the cerebellar system for slurred speech), then let the tempo predict the type of lesion for the differential
